name: Codersly ERP: ERP for Small Business with HRM, CRM, Accounting & WooCommerce Pro Placeholder
author: Codersly

sections.description:
Codersly ERP is an ERP for Small Business plugin for WordPress. It helps small business owners, agencies, service providers, startups, and company admins manage basic HRM, CRM, Accounting, company, reports, settings, and CSV records from the WordPress admin dashboard.

Use Codersly ERP when you need a simple small business ERP plugin inside WordPress for employees, departments, leave, holidays, CRM contacts, companies, tasks, customers, vendors, income/expense transactions, products, reports, settings, and import/export tools.

The Free plugin includes practical admin screens for daily business record management. Advanced automation, WooCommerce sync, payroll, attendance, inventory, purchase orders, employee portal workflows, and other premium logic are kept in Codersly ERP Pro. Free Pro screens are upgrade placeholders only.

Key Free Features

  • Admin dashboard for small business ERP management
  • Company profile with Profile, Setup Wizard, Working Days, and Fiscal Year & Currency screens
  • Basic HRM overview for employee management
  • Employee, department, designation, announcement, employee profile view, search, import, and export screens
  • Leave request, approve/reject actions, holiday, policy, entitlement, calendar, and HRM report screens
  • CRM contacts, companies, groups, notes, tasks, basic follow-ups, and CRM report screens
  • Accounting customers, vendors, income/expense transactions, products/services, profit/loss summary, reports, and settings
  • Tools, demo data loader, settings, CSV import/export, and Pro placeholder screens
  • WooCommerce Integration Pro placeholder for orders, customers, products, stock, reports, and ERP accounting sync
  • Upgrade Pro comparison page for clear Free vs Pro feature positioning
  • Bangladesh-friendly BDT/currency default business settings
  • Pro placeholders without premium business logic

ERP for Small Business

Codersly ERP is built for small business teams that want an admin-based ERP system inside WordPress. The plugin focuses on simple business record management instead of complex enterprise-level ERP workflows.

Small business owners can use the Free version to organize basic HRM, CRM, Accounting, company, report, and settings records from one WordPress admin menu.

HRM for Small Business

Codersly ERP includes basic HRM screens for employee management, departments, designations, announcements, leave requests, holidays, leave policies, leave entitlements, leave calendar, and HRM reports.

CRM for Small Business

Codersly ERP includes CRM screens for contacts, companies, customer groups, notes, tasks, basic follow-ups, and CRM reports. Small teams can organize customer and company information without leaving WordPress.

Accounting for Small Business

Codersly ERP includes accounting screens for customers, vendors, income/expense transactions, products or services, basic profit/loss reports, and settings. These screens are designed for simple admin-based business record management inside WordPress.

WooCommerce Integration Pro Placeholder

Codersly ERP Free includes a WooCommerce Integration Pro placeholder for premium WooCommerce ERP workflows such as order sync, customer sync, product sync, stock or inventory sync, sales reports, and ERP accounting sync.

WooCommerce sync logic is not included in the Free plugin. The Free screen is provided only as a clear upgrade path for users who need WooCommerce ERP automation in Codersly ERP Pro.

Premium Feature Placeholders

Premium placeholders include Payroll, Attendance, Assets, Recruitment, Documents, Training, Performance, Approvals, Org Chart, Employee Frontend Portal, CRM Deals, CRM Automation, Email Sync, Reimbursements, Inventory, Purchase Orders, WooCommerce Integration, Advanced Reports, Audit Logs, White Label, and Integrations.

Upgrade to Codersly ERP Pro for premium ERP features:
https://codersly.com/product/codersly-erp-pro-for-small-business-wordpress-plugin-license/

Who Is Codersly ERP For?

Codersly ERP is built for small businesses, startups, local companies, agencies, service providers, and WordPress site owners who want an admin-based ERP, HRM, CRM, and Accounting system without leaving WordPress.

Data Preservation

Codersly ERP Free does not delete saved HRM, CRM, Accounting, Company, or Settings data when the plugin is deactivated, uninstalled, or deleted. Single-record archive actions are soft-delete; Delete All clears the selected table.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP file from the WordPress admin.
  2. Activate Codersly ERP.
  3. Go to Codersly ERP in the WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Start with Company setup, then add HRM, CRM, or Accounting records as needed.
  5. Review Pro placeholder screens if your business needs advanced ERP workflows.
sections.faq:
Is Codersly ERP an ERP for Small Business?

Yes. Codersly ERP is designed as an ERP for Small Business plugin for WordPress. It provides admin-based HRM, CRM, Accounting, company, reports, and settings screens for basic business record management.

Can I use Codersly ERP as a small business ERP plugin in WordPress?

Yes. You can use Codersly ERP to manage basic employees, leave requests, CRM contacts, companies, customers, vendors, transactions, products or services, reports, and settings from the WordPress admin dashboard.

Can I use Codersly ERP without WooCommerce?

Yes. Codersly ERP can be used for HRM, CRM, Accounting, company records, reports, settings, and CSV tools without WooCommerce.

Does the Free plugin include WooCommerce sync?

No. WooCommerce order, customer, product, inventory, sales report, and accounting sync are premium features handled by Codersly ERP Pro.

Why do I see WooCommerce and other Pro screens in the Free plugin?

Those screens are Pro placeholders. They explain premium workflows but do not include premium business logic in the Free plugin.

Does the Free plugin include license activation?

No. License activation belongs to Codersly ERP Pro. The Free plugin does not create a License menu.

Does the Free plugin contain Pro business logic?

No. The Free plugin only displays upgrade placeholders for Pro features. Premium business logic is kept in Codersly ERP Pro.

Which Pro features are shown as placeholders?

The Free plugin shows placeholders for Payroll, Attendance, Assets, Recruitment, Documents, Training, Performance, Approvals, Org Chart, Employee Frontend Portal, CRM Deals, CRM Automation, Email Sync, Reimbursements, Inventory, Purchase Orders, WooCommerce Integration, Advanced Reports, Audit Logs, White Label, and Integrations.

Does Codersly ERP delete my saved data on uninstall?

No. Codersly ERP Free does not delete saved HRM, CRM, Accounting, Company, or Settings data when the plugin is deactivated, uninstalled, or deleted. Single-record archive actions are soft-delete; Delete All clears the selected table.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Added Company tabbed setup with Profile, Setup Wizard, Working Days, and Fiscal Year & Currency screens.
  • Added Demo Data loader under Tools for safe sample employees, leave, CRM, follow-ups, accounting, and products.
  • Added basic employee profile view action from the Employees table.
  • Added quick approve/reject actions for Free leave requests.
  • Added Basic CRM Follow-ups screen with contact, date, type, priority, status, and notes.
  • Added consolidated Reports menu with HR, CRM, Accounting, and Pro Export Center tabs.
  • Added computed basic accounting profit/loss summary from saved transactions.
  • Added WooCommerce Accounting Mapping Pro placeholder tab.
  • Added Upgrade Pro comparison page for clearer Free vs Pro positioning.
  • Updated default business settings for Bangladesh-friendly BDT/currency options.

1.0.3

  • Added WooCommerce Integration Pro placeholder under Accounting for premium order, customer, product, inventory, sales report, and ERP accounting sync.
  • Added module-specific dashboard, tab, placeholder, and sidebar icons; the main sidebar uses the Codersly ERP brand icon.
  • Fixed sidebar brand icon active/inactive states and replaced ecommerce-style icons outside WooCommerce screens.
  • Updated Free dashboard Pro highlights for Codersly ERP Pro 1.0.3 compatibility.
  • Kept WooCommerce sync implementation out of the Free plugin; Free screen remains an upgrade placeholder only.

1.0.2

  • Improved readme SEO, admin UI, Free-to-Pro rendering, dropdown handling, placeholder routing, and Pro compatibility.

1.0.1

  • Initial WordPress.org submission with HRM, CRM, Accounting, Company, Settings, CSV tools, security checks, and Pro placeholders.
